description: This file contains a JUnit test class for testing the default header setting behavior of MessageCommandAckRequestSetter in the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests various combinations of header parameters like timeout, response required, and requested acknowledgments.

classes.name: MessageCommandAckRequestSetterDefaultHeaderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the default header setting functionality of MessageCommandAckRequestSetter, especially focusing on timeout, response required, and acknowledgement headers.

methods.name: parameters
methods.description: Generates all combinations of timeout, response required, and requested acknowledgments parameters for testing.

methods.name: willNeverGenerateInvalidHeadersFromValidHeaders
methods.description: Tests that the headers generated are valid by asserting the header validity validity conditions.

methods.name: getMessageCommand
methods.description: Builds a MessageCommand object with headers set according to the test parameters.
